verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is documented as an API-first product with a full API reference (card and cardholder creation). The only hint of official SDKs is the llms.txt note to check the npm registry when installing Stripe packages, which implies official client libraries but does not document them. missing for 10: explicit documentation of official SDKs and supported languages, SDK coverage of Issuing endpoints, code samples, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
